indication_area: Oncology (BRAF V600-mutant melanoma, colorectal and lung cancer)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 210498 NDA APPROVAL ... for Mektovi tablet, 15 mg ... Mektovi (binimetinib) 15 mg tablet, in combination with encorafenib, for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation (electronically signed 06/27/2018)

series_start_reason: Pfizer completed its acquisition of Array BioPharma on July 30, 2019 and first prints the brand as its own line in the fourth-quarter 2019 release (current quarter, prior-year column a nil dash). The third-quarter 2019 release (2019-10-29) and the third-quarter 2019 10-Q print no row for the brand; 2019Q3 is read from the prior-year column of the third-quarter 2020 release. The series therefore starts 2019Q3, the first quarter Pfizer held the product. Array BioPharma (CIK 0001100412) printed net product sales per brand in its own 10-Qs for fiscal quarters ended September 30, 2018, December 31, 2018 and March 31, 2019 (accessions 0001100412-18-000037, 0001100412-19-000005 and 0001100412-19-000021, in thousands: Braftovi 7,015, 11,371 and 17,351; Mektovi 6,978, 11,342 and 17,727). Array's fiscal year ended June 30 and it was acquired on July 30, 2019; its filing list shows no 10-K or 10-Q after the 2019-05-07 10-Q (Form 15 on 2019-08-09), and Pfizer's first release carrying the products is the third-quarter 2019 release, so 2019Q2 (April-June 2019) is printed by no issuer. Those three Array quarters therefore cannot be joined to Pfizer's series without a gap and are not in the CSV.
series_end_reason: From the first-quarter 2024 release Pfizer prints one combined line 'Braftovi/Mektovi' (first quarter 2024: 116 against 103 a year earlier) instead of separate lines. The combined line is not the sum of the separate lines it replaces: for the first quarter of 2023 the separate lines print 49 and 40 (sum 89) while the combined line's prior-year column prints 103, and for full-year 2023 the separate lines sum to 387 against 477 on the combined line (Recasted Product Revenue Tables, April 2024). No document reconciles the difference; the same recast document says royalty income was reclassified into revenues from January 1, 2024, which is consistent with but not stated to explain it. The combined line is a different scope, so the brand series stops at 2023Q4.
notes: Pfizer's worldwide revenue line named for the brand; Mektovi is used with Braftovi (melanoma, and NSCLC from October 2023); the line is the brand total. Scope proved from the table: every Worldwide figure is the first column of the product row under the column groups WORLDWIDE | UNITED STATES | TOTAL INTERNATIONAL. The International columns of the row print a nil dash in every release through the first-quarter 2022 release; the first nonzero International figure is printed in the third-quarter 2022 release (nine-month row), so the Worldwide figure is essentially the U.S. figure before then and includes a small international part (1 to 3) afterwards. The United States column is a narrower line but is not used; the series is kept on the one Worldwide scope throughout. Pfizer prints both brands as separate lines; the other brand of the pair is in its own manifest.
search_log: Listed Pfizer (CIK 0000078003) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages), all forms incl. 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-K, 10-Q; selected 8-Ks with Item 2.02 filed 2018-01 to 2026-08 (35 earnings releases read; the 2022-04-20, 2023-10-13 and 2023-12-14 filings are not quarterly earnings releases) and read each EX-99.1; fetched every 10-Q/10-K filed 2019-02 to 2026-08 and scanned table rows for the product names.

Table rows were taken from the HTML <tr> rows of each exhibit; the quarter figure is the first occurrence of the product row (the quarter block under WORLDWIDE | UNITED STATES | TOTAL INTERNATIONAL); later occurrences are international sub-regions and year-to-date blocks.

Releases for 2019Q1-2019Q3 and the 10-Qs for those quarters print no brand row (Pfizer owned neither product before July 30, 2019); the third-quarter 2019 release only mentions the Array acquisition in prose.

Annual check: quarters sum to the twelve-month figures printed in the fourth-quarter releases within rounding of whole millions: 2019 49 (19+30), 2020 142, 2021 154 against 155 printed, 2022 175 against 176 printed, 2023 174.
Searched Array BioPharma (CIK 1100412) filings 2018-08 to 2019-08: per-brand net product sales exist for three quarters but not 2019Q2; see series_start_reason.

Launch quarter not established from a Pfizer document: Pfizer's own documents start at its 2019 ownership; Array's launch statements were not searched beyond the 10-Qs above, so launch_quarter is left null.

Checked the combined Braftovi/Mektovi line (first-quarter 2024 release onward, through the second-quarter 2026 release: 174 and 136 for the first quarters 2026 and 2025, 223 and 182 for the second quarters) and the Recasted 2023 and 2025/2024 Product Revenue Tables (investor-relations PDFs); not used, see series_end_reason.
